newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy premier says ERM decision today or Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Italy premier says ERM decision today or Sunday.

text.p: Italy's Prime Minister Romano Prodi said a final decision on readmitting the lira into the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM) would be taken today or on Sunday, Italian news agency ANSA reported on Saturday.
"Today or tomorrow there will be a conclusive decision," Prodi told reporters outside his home in the North Italian city of Bologna.

An EU monetary said earlier that talks on the lira's re-entry to the EU's Exchange Rate Mechanism ran into difficulties on Saturday and a meeting of EU finance ministers could be needed to resolve the problems.
"The positions are still far apart," the source said. "A meeting of the ECOFIN ministers cannot be excluded at this time."
The ministers would only be brought in if a political decision was needed to break a deadlock between EU finance ministry and central bank officials currently discussing the lira's return.
Rome hopes that by returning to the EU's currency grid it will qualify for the single European currency in 1999.
